project_type: Laravel 13 monolith — MySQL backend, Blade + Tailwind v4 frontend
build_system: Composer 2.8.11 for PHP deps; Vite 8 + laravel-vite-plugin for JS/CSS. Tailwind v4 uses @tailwindcss/vite plugin — NO tailwind.config.js, NO tailwind v3. Run: npm install then npm run build. CSS entry: resources/css/app.css (has @import 'tailwindcss'). JS entry: resources/js/app.js.
test_framework: PHPUnit 12 (vendor/bin/phpunit). Tests live in tests/Feature/ and tests/Unit/. phpunit.xml already configured for SQLite in-memory (DB_CONNECTION=sqlite, DB_DATABASE=:memory:) so no MySQL needed for tests.
verification_instructions:
1. php artisan migrate:fresh --seed (verifies migrations + seeders)
2. npm run build (verifies Vite/Tailwind compilation)
3. php artisan test (runs PHPUnit suite, all must pass)
4. php artisan route:list (spot-check routes)
5. php artisan storage:link (creates public/storage symlink)
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/build/ is generated by npm run build. Do not commit it. public/storage is a symlink created by php artisan storage:link.
environment_constraints: Windows 11, PowerShell. PHP 8.4.12 at C:\php8\php.exe. MySQL 8.0.43. No Redis, no queues needed. SESSION_DRIVER=database and CACHE_STORE=database are already in .env — the sessions/cache/jobs tables exist in the default migrations. DB password in .env: shoaibmesta2002 — never echo this.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md only contains the laravel-boost bootstrap instructions (install Laravel Boost) — those have already been handled. No other workspace-level contribution rules exist. Laravel 13 uses bootstrap/app.php fluent API for middleware: use ->withMiddleware() to register aliases. No Http/Kernel.php.
key_patterns: 1. User model uses PHP 8 #[Fillable] and #[Hidden] attributes — FEAT-001 switches to conventional $fillable/$hidden arrays to allow adding is_admin. 2. Routes: all admin routes are under prefix('admin')->name('admin.')->middleware(['auth','admin']) group. 3. Admin middleware alias 'admin' maps to App\Http\Middleware\EnsureIsAdmin. 4. Slug uniqueness: loop Str::slug($name).'-'.$n until unique. 5. Image path stored as relative path from Storage disk root (e.g. 'products/uuid.jpg'), retrieved via Storage::disk('public')->url($path). 6. All money as decimal(12,2) — never float. 7. Storefront queries must filter: product.is_active=true AND category.is_active=true AND subcategory.is_active=true.
directory_structure: app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ — admin controllers; app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ — login controller; app/Http/Controllers/ — StorefrontController; app/Http/Middleware/ — EnsureIsAdmin; app/Http/Requests/Admin/ — Form Requests; app/Models/ — Category, Subcategory, Product, User; app/Services/ — ProductImageService; database/migrations/ — all migrations; database/factories/ — all factories; database/seeders/ — DatabaseSeeder; resources/views/layouts/ — admin.blade.php, storefront.blade.php; resources/views/admin/{categories,subcategories,products,auth,dashboard}; resources/views/storefront/{home,category,subcategory,product,partials}; tests/Feature/Admin/ — AuthTest, CategoryCrudTest, SubcategoryCrudTest, ProductCrudTest; tests/Feature/ — StorefrontTest; public/images/ — placeholder.png
